sentence.en: I am uniting the team around a common goal.
sentence.ar: أنا أوحد الفريق حول هدف مشترك.

examples.en: I unite the team around a common goal.

examples.en: I am not uniting the team around a common goal.

examples.en: I united the team around a common goal.
